epic.title: Search filters
epic.description: Screens D1–D3: keeper filters ported from the Python build, safe to transfer, family strings, the filter builder and saved filters.

features.title: Keeper filters
tasks: PvP keeper strings: Great League (2 parts) and Ultra League (3 parts) with 1,950-character splitting
Raid attackers (Attack 11–15 / 15 only), Max Battle attackers, Megas (with / without pre-evolutions)
Rebuilt by the daily import; golden-file checked
Keepers screen: cards, suggested tags, Copy per part with Copied state, how-to

features.title: Safe to transfer
tasks: Tag-based inverse string with exclusions and safety note

features.title: Family strings
tasks: Short family string on each Pokémon page

features.title: Filter builder
tasks: Condition model: 10 groups; AND between conditions, OR inside one
String generator for English game keywords
Parse hand-edited strings back into conditions where possible
Live check with the search simulator, length counter, automatic split
Phone add-condition sheet with search; desktop three columns

features.title: Saved filters
tasks: API: save, list, rename, duplicate, delete (per user)
Saved list with Copy and ⋯ menu; save sheet; signed-out prompt
